questions.subject: PHYSICS_EM
questions.topic: Poynting vector at the surface of a cylindrical resistor
questions.stem: Surface E=200 V/m, B=3e-4 T; find S in W/m^2.
questions.explanation: S = EB/mu0 = 200*3e-4/(4pi e-7)=47.7 W/m^2. The tempting wrong idea is to multiply by mu0.

questions.subject: PHYSICS_EM
questions.topic: Net power flowing into a resistor from its supply
questions.stem: Resistor draws 3.0 A at 9.0 V; find power in W.
questions.explanation: Power = I V = 3*9 = 27 W. The tempting wrong idea is to use I^2 R without R.
